```text
vendir allows to declaratively state what should be in a directory (sync, tools, version)

Usage:
  vendir [flags]
  vendir [command]

Available Commands:
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help        Help about any command
  sync        Sync directories
  tools       Tools (sort-semver)
  version     Print client version

Flags:
      --color            Set color output (default true)
      --column strings   Filter to show only given columns
  -h, --help             help for vendir
      --json             Output as JSON
      --tty              Force TTY-like output
  -v, --version          version for vendir
  -y, --yes              Assume yes for any prompt

Use "vendir [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Succeeded
```
